english: Why do my tomato plants suddenly wilt and die in the afternoon even when the soil has water?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ gboiɔ yɛ shwane mli lɛ? Ani nu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lolo?

english: This is often caused by bacterial wilt in the soil. The bacteria block the tiny water pipes inside the plant stem, so even if the ground is wet, water cannot reach the top leaves.
ga: Bei pii lɛ muawai ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ ni egboɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛbaa. Muawai tsiɔ nu paipii bibii anaa. tso lɛ shishi No hewɔ lɛ kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ po Nu nyɛŋ ashɛ baai lɛ anɔ.

english: Why do people say planting groundnuts together with my cassava helps the farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛɔ akɛ ŋmei ni mikɛ mi-cassava lɛ duɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ŋmɔ lɛ?

english: Groundnuts are legumes that pull nitrogen from the air and store it in their roots. When those roots decay, they feed natural fertilizer into the soil that nearby cassava plants can use.
ga: Peanuts ji ŋmeii ni jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli. Beni nakai shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii woɔ shikpɔŋ ni ŋmei tsei ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ baanyɛ amɛkɛtsu nii lɛ mli.

english: Why do the seeds I saved from my harvested maize give me small cobs if I plant them again?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni mibua naa kɛjɛɔ ŋmãa lɛ mli lɛ woɔ ŋmãa bibii lɛ? Kɛji midu ekoŋŋ?

english: Hybrid seeds are specially crossed once to give big yields, but their children (saved seeds) lose that power. Planting saved hybrid seeds usually results in weaker plants and smaller harvests.
ga: Akɛ dumɔwui ni akɛfee ekome lɛ shwieɔ shikome yɛ gbɛ krɛdɛɛ nɔ koni amɛwo yibii babaoo, shi amɛbii (dumɔwui ni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ) laajeɔ nakai hewalɛ lɛ. Bei pii lɛ, dumɔwui ni aŋmala amɛhe saji awo mli ni aduɔ lɛ haa tsei lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ni amɛwoɔ yibii fioo.

english: Cassava roots rot underground when water sits around them for too long due to poor soil drainage. Planting cassava on raised mounds or ridges helps excess rainwater run away from the roots.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi kɛ́ nu ebɔle amɛhe. sɛɛ tsɛɔ tsɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nu ni hoɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ hewɔ Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ loo ŋshɔkei lɛ anɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shishifãi lɛ ahe.

english: Why do small worms hide deep inside the center leaves of my young corn stalks?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii bibii kɛ amɛhe ewo mi-abɛi bibii lɛ ateŋ baai lɛ amli shɔŋŋ lɛ?

english: These are likely Fall Armyworms. They hide deep inside the funnel of the plant because the leaf tissue there is soft and safe from bird attacks and heat.
ga: Ekolɛ Fall Armyworms ji enɛɛmɛi. Amɛteɔ amɛhe amɛwoɔ tsei akui amli shɔŋŋ ejaakɛ baai lɛ amli fãji ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ yɛ bɔdɔɔ ni okpoi kɛ dɔlɛ baatutua amɛ.

english: Leaf curling and yellowing are usually signs of a plant illness caused by tiny insects like whiteflies spreading cassava mosaic disease. It shows the plant is sick and unable to process its food properly.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni shwieɔ shi kɛ ŋmɔŋ ji tso hela ni kooloi bibii tamɔ ŋmeii yɛŋ ni gbɛɔ cassava mosaic hela lɛ eshwaa lɛ kɛbaa lɛ he okadi. Etsɔɔ akɛ hela mɔ tso lɛ ni enyɛɛɛ etsu niyenii he nii jogbaŋŋ.

english: How can I tell if my crop is sick from a disease or if insects are damaging it?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ helai loo kooloi bibii miifite miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ?

english: Insect damage usually leaves visible holes, chewed leaf edges, or bite marks on the plant. Diseases usually show up as spots, widespread discoloration, rotting areas, or wilting without visible bugs eating the leaves.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi ni fiteɔ nii lɛ haa buji ni anaa lɛ shwieɔ shi. baai ni ashɛreɔ loo ŋmɔlɔ he okadii ni yɔɔ tsei anɔ. Bei pii lɛ, helai jeɔ kpo akɛ ŋmɔtɔ. He ni su tsakeɔ babaoo ni fiteɔ loo egboɔ ni kooloi yeee baai lɛ

english: Why do my maize leaves turn pale yellow, and how do I know the plants need food?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele baai lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni mli tse lɛ? Ni te mafee tɛŋŋ male tsei ni niyenii he hiaa amɛ lɛ?

english: Yellow leaves, especially starting from the bottom of the plant, mean the maize lacks nitrogen, which is essential plant food. Plants need nutrients from fertilizer just like humans need food to grow strong and green.
ga: Baai ni ji ŋmɔŋ titri lɛ jeɔ shishi kɛjɛɔ tso lɛ shishi. Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen, ni ji tsei aniyenii ni he hiaa waa lɛ bɛ ŋmãa mli. Tsei he miihia niyenii ni jɛɔ ŋmɔshi nibii amli. Taakɛ niyenii he hiaa adesai koni amɛdara jogbaŋŋ ni amɛfee ŋmɔji lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english: Why does planting the same crop on my land every year make my harvest smaller?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ni ŋmɔshi nibii kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ ni miduɔ yɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ daa afi lɛ haa miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ baa shi lɛ?

english: Growing the same crop every season consumes the exact same nutrients from the soil over and over. This starves the land of specific plant food and allows soil diseases that target that specific crop to build up.
ga: Tsei komekomei ni aduɔ daa be lɛ biɔ niyenii kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli shii abɔ. Enɛ haa hɔmɔ yeɔ he ni ŋmɔshi nibii komɛi yɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ helai ni baa nakai ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ anɔ lɛ baa.

english: Why do weeds make my crops grow smaller and weaker?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi haa miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ feɔ bibii ni amɛhe waaa lɛ?

english: Weeds act like thieves on your farm; they drink the water and eat up the fertilizer meant for your crops. Because the weeds steal these essential nutrients, your crops end up hungry and stunted.
ga: Jwɛi feɔ amɛnii tamɔ julɔi yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ mli. Amɛnuɔ nu lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛyeɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni ato he gbɛjianɔ kɛha onibii lɛ. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, jwɛi juɔ niyenii ni he hiaa nɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ miiye oŋmɔshi nibii ni egbɔjɔ.

english: Why do my tomato leaves wilt during the hot afternoon sun even when the ground is moist?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli eyɛ mli akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ moŋ?

english: In intense heat, tomato plants lose moisture through their leaves faster than their roots can suck it up from the soil. They wilt temporarily to protect themselves and conserve water until the air cools down in the evening.
ga: Yɛ hulutsoo be ni naa wa lɛ mli lɛ, Tomato tsei lɛ fiteɔ nu kɛtsɔɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ oya fe bɔ ni amɛshishifãi lɛ baanyɛ ajie kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Amɛbaabu amɛhe he ni amɛbaakwɛ nu nɔ be kukuoo ko kɛyashi be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli baajɔ gbɛkɛ.

english: How do I know if my pepper plants are getting too much water from heavy rain?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ mi-pepper tsei lɛ miiná nu babaoo kɛmiijɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli?

english: When pepper plants sit in stagnant water, their roots drown because they cannot get air. The leaves will turn pale, drop off, and the bottom of the stem near the soil may start to rot.
ga: Kɛji akɛ pepper tso lɛ ta nu ni mli ejɔ mli lɛ Eshishifãi lɛ baagbee shi ejaakɛ amɛnyɛŋ amɛná kɔɔyɔɔ, baai lɛ baatsɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ, amɛbaagbee shi, ni tso lɛ shishi ni bɛŋkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baanyɛ aje shishi egbo.

english: Why do my young crops grow tall and skinny when planted under big trees?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ midumɔwu lɛ kɛlɛ ni eyɛ mlɛo kɛ́ adu lɛ yɛ tso agbo ko shishi lɛ?

english: Crops need direct sunlight to make their food. When blocked by shade, the plant stretches upwards quickly toward the light, making its stem weak and thin instead of strong and bushy.
ga: Tsei taoɔ hulu la tɛ̃ɛ koni amɛfee niyenii. Kɛji akɛ hulutsoo ha tso lɛ nɔ lɛ, eshɛɔ oya kɛyaa ŋwɛi kɛyaa la lɛ he. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ feɔ gbɔjɔmɔ ni amɛhe waaa moŋ fe ni amɛaafee hewalɛ ni amɛfee ŋmɔji.

english: Pepper plants drop flowers when they are stressed by extreme heat, poor watering, or lack of key soil food like phosphorus. The plant drops its flowers to save energy when growing conditions are difficult.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ baafɔfɔi ashwie shi kɛji dɔlɛ ni naa wa hao amɛ. nu ni ehiii loo niyenii mli nibii titrii ni bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, tamɔ fɔsfɔs lɛ, tsei lɛ baashwie fɔfɔi koni amɛkɛbu hewalɛ he kɛji shihilɛi ni haa amɛdaraa lɛ mli wa.

english: What happens if I plant my crop seeds too close together in the field?
ga: Mɛni baa kɛji midu dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ yɛ ŋmɔ mli?

english: Planting seeds too close together makes the crops fight one another for sunlight, soil food, and water. As a result, none of them get enough nourishment, leading to weak stems and small yields.
ga: Dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ haa tsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la, shikpɔŋ mli niyenii, kɛ nu he akaŋ, ni no haa tsei lɛ eko kwraa náaa niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji tsei ni bɛ hewalɛ kɛ yibiiwoo ni baa shi.

english: Young cocoa plants need shade to protect their delicate leaves from harsh sunlight while their roots establish. Leaving some tall shade trees or planting plantains alongside them keeps the air humid and soil cool so the young cocoa can survive.
ga: Kookoo tsei bibii lɛ hia hulutsoo koni amɛbu amɛbaai ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ ahe kɛjɛ hulu la ni naa wa lɛ he yɛ be mli ni amɛshishifãi lɛ ema shi lɛ. tsei kakadaji ni ajieɔ lɛ Ha hulutsoo loo dumɔ dumɔwui yɛ emasɛi. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ. Enɛ ji bɔni afee ni kookoo bibii lɛ anyɛ ahi shi.

english: Why do my cassava tubers rot underground when there is heavy rainfall for many days?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi kɛ́ nugbɔ nɛ waa gbii babaoo lɛ?

english: Cassava roots rot when water settles around them without draining away, which starves the tubers of air. Planting cassava on raised mounds or ridges allows excess rainwater to flow away from the roots.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu bua amɛhe naa yɛ amɛhe. ni ekɛ nu ejeee kpo Enɛ baaha kɔɔyɔɔ yitso lɛ afee nɔ ni kɔɔyɔɔ bɛ mli. Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ loo ŋshɔkei lɛ anɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shishifãi lɛ ahe.

english: Why shouldn't I let all the small suckers grow around my main plantain tree?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ miŋmɛɔ gbɛ ni ŋmeii bibii shwereɔ yɛ midumɔwu titri lɛ he lɛ?

english: Allowing too many suckers to grow causes them to steal water and food from the main plant, resulting in small plantain bunches. Pruning away extra suckers so only one or two remain ensures the main plant produces large, heavy fruit.
ga: Kɛ́ aŋmɛ gbɛ ni ŋmeii babaoo kwɛ̃ lɛ, ebaaha amɛju nu kɛ niyenii kɛjɛ tso titri lɛ mli. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji plantains bibii bibii. Kɛ́ afolɔ tsei ni fa fe nine lɛ amli koni eshwɛ ekome loo enyɔ pɛ lɛ, ehaa tso titri lɛ woɔ yibii wuji ni tsii.

english: Why do I need to use stakes to lift my yam vines off the bare ground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tso he hiaa mi koni mikɛwo mi-sweet potato wain tsei lɛ anɔ kɛjɛ he ko ni gbɛ yɔɔ lɛ?

english: Lifting yam leaves onto stakes exposes them to full sunlight so they can make food to build large tubers underground, while keeping the leaves away from wet soil prevents fungal diseases.
ga: Kɛ́ awó sweet potato baai lɛ anɔ yɛ tso ko nɔ lɛ, ehaa amɛnáa hulu la ni fa babaoo ni amɛkɛhooɔ nii, ni ehaa hulutsoo be wuji baa shikpɔŋ shishi. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ha baai lɛ akashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli efɔ nɔ koni tsɛŋemɔ helai akamɔ bo.

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when they experience extreme heat or dry soil stress as a defense mechanism to save water and energy. Keeping the soil consistently moist helps the plant keep its flowers.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛji akɛ amɛyashɛ hulutsoo ni naa wa loo nɔnyɛɛ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ lɛ he. Taakɛ hebuu gbɛ ni akɛbaahere nu kɛ hewalɛ. Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa tso lɛ ni ehiɛɔ efɔfɔi lɛ amli.

english: Yellowing lower leaves show that the maize plant lacks nitrogen, which is the key food it needs for growth. When nitrogen in the soil runs low, the plant pulls nutrients from its older bottom leaves to feed the young top leaves.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ ŋmãa tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa kɛha dalɛ Beni nitrogen fioo pɛ yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Tsei lɛ gbalaa niyenii kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ baai ni edara lɛ amli koni amɛkɛha ŋwɛi baai bibii lɛ niyenii.

english: Why is it beneficial for me to plant groundnuts or cowpeas on my field before I plant maize next season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he akɛ madu ŋmei loo tsina ŋmei yɛ ŋmɔ mli dani madu be ni baa lɛ mli ŋmei lɛ?

english: Legumes like groundnuts and cowpeas take nitrogen from the air and store it in the soil through their roots. This naturally fertilizes the soil so your next maize crop grows strong with less added chemical fertilizer.
ga: Legumes tamɔ ŋmei kɛ tsina ŋmei jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ. Enɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ afee ŋmɔshi nii yɛ adebɔɔ naa. No hewɔ lɛ, o-maise ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ daa waa kɛ tsofa ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ fioo pɛ.

english: Why shouldn't I drop chemical fertilizer directly against the main stem of my young plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ mikɛ tsofai ni haa ŋmɔshi nibii woɔ tsei bibii lɛ ashishifã titri lɛ mli tɛ̃ɛ lɛ?

english: Placing fertilizer right against the stem concentrates harsh salts that can burn the stem tissue and root system. Fertilizer should be placed in a circle a few inches away from the stem so roots can safely absorb it.
ga: Kɛ́ akɛ tsofa wo tsei lɛ amli lɛ, ehaa ŋmeii babaoo ni baanyɛ ashã tso lɛ mli fãji kɛ shishifãi lɛ baa. Esa akɛ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli yɛ kooyigbɛ ni kɛ tso lɛ teŋ jɛkɛmɔ ji inchi fioo ko bɔni afee ni shishifãi lɛ anyɛ aŋɔ lɛ shweshweeshwe.

english: Why do the leaves of my pepper plants curl upward and turn crinkly?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper baai lɛ miiho ni amɛmiibɔle amɛhe lɛ?

english: Leaf curl in peppers is caused by tiny sucking insects like aphids or whiteflies feeding on the sap and transmitting viruses. Spraying the leaves with neem oil or recommended organic treatments helps control these pests early.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ chili baa curl baa ji kooloi bibii ni nuɔ nii tamɔ aphids loo whiteflies ni yeɔ nu lɛ mli nu lɛ ni amɛgbɛɔ hela lɛ amɛshwãa lɛ. Kɛ́ okɛ neem fɔ loo tsofai krokomɛi ni atsɔɔ akɛ akɛ tsofai tsuɔ nii yɛ mli lɛ shwie baai lɛ anɔ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni akudɔ nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ mra.

english: Why do pests and diseases get worse when I plant tomatoes on the exact same plot of land every year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tsɛŋemɔ helai kɛ helai ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ mli woɔ wu waa kɛ́ midu tomato yɛ he kome daa afi lɛ?

english: Planting the same crop repeatedly allows crop-specific pests and diseases to build up high populations in the soil year after year. Rotating with unrelated crops like maize breaks the pest life cycle.
ga: Tso kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ ni oookwɛ shii abɔ Enɛ baaha tso pɔtɛɛ ko mli tsɛŋemɔ helai kɛ helai ayibɔ aya hiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ daa afi. Nibii ni aduɔ ni kɛ amɛhe bɛ tsakpaa, tamɔ ŋmãa ni akɛtsakeɔ amɛhe lɛ haa tsɛŋemɔ hela lɛ wala shihilɛ kpaa.

english: Why are the leaves on my young maize plants full of ragged holes and looking like something chewed them overnight?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-baby corn tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ eyi kɛ bu ni etse ni etamɔ nɔ ko ni ŋmɔ amɛ nyɔɔŋ kome lɛ?

english: This damage is usually caused by Fall Armyworm caterpillars that hide inside the central stalk during the day and eat the soft leaves. Inspecting your field early and applying recommended bio-pesticides or neem extract into the leaf funnel can stop them before they destroy the crop.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, Fall Armyworm ŋmeii ni kɛ amɛhe woɔ tso lɛ teŋgbɛ yɛ gbi lɛ mli ni amɛyeɔ baai bibii lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa. Odumɔi lɛ amli kwɛmɔ mra Ni okɛ tsofa ko ni gbeɔ kooloi loo neem mli nu ni akɛwoɔ baai lɛ amli lɛ baatsu nii lɛ baanyɛ aha amɛkpa dani amɛfite ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ.

english: Leaf curling is often caused by very tiny sucking insects like whiteflies or thrips feeding on the sap and passing along plant viruses. Spraying soapy water or suitable insecticides early keeps these insects away and lets the plant grow healthy new leaves.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, koolooi bibii ni nuɔ nu, tamɔ whiteflies loo thrips, ni yeɔ nu lɛ ni amɛgbɛɔ muawai amɛshwãa tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baa lɛ shwieɔ shi. Nu ni akɛ samla loo tsofa ni gbeɔ kooloi lɛ shwieɔ nɔ mra ni sa. Enɛ baaye abua ni nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ akashɛ ohe. ni eyeɔ ebuaa tsei ni amɛnáa baai heei ni mli wa

english: Legumes like groundnuts and cowpeas have natural nodules on their roots that capture nitrogen from the air and store it in the ground. When these plants die and rot, they leave behind rich natural plant food that helps maize grow tall without needing as much artificial fertilizer.
ga: Legumes tamɔ ŋmei kɛ tsina ŋmei yɛ adebɔɔ mli ŋmeii ni yɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ ni mɔ̃ɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛ tsei nɛɛ gboi ni amɛfite lɛ Amɛshiɔ adebɔɔ mli tsei niyenii ni jara wa ni yeɔ ebuaa ŋmãa ni ekwɛ̃ɔ ni ehe ehiaaa ni akɛ ŋmãa ni akɛfee ŋmãa babaoo awo mli.

english: Why does my land stop growing good crops if I plant cassava on the exact same farm every single year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ kpaɔ ŋmɔshi nibii kpakpai kɛji miduɔ ŋmãa yɛ ŋmɔ kome mli daa afi lɛ?

english: Cassava takes heavy amounts of nutrients out of the earth as its big tubers grow. Planting it year after year in the same spot exhausts the soil strength and lets disease build up, which is why rotating with crops like beans or letting the land rest restores soil energy.
ga: Cassava gbalaa niyenii babaoo kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ be mli ni ŋmeii lɛ daraa lɛ. Kɛ́ adu tsei afi fɛɛ afi yɛ he kome lɛ, ebaanyɛ eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ aba shi ni ekɛ helai aba. Enɛ hewɔ ni ehe hiaa ni atsake ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ ŋmeii loo aha shikpɔŋ lɛ aná hewalɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ.

english: Why do I need to plant plantains or shade trees next to my young cocoa seedlings?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni madu dumɔwui loo tsei ni haa hulu tsoɔ yɛ emasɛi lɛ? Mi kookoo tso bibioo lɛ

english: Young cocoa plants are very tender and can burn easily under hot, direct sunlight. Plantains grow fast and have large leaves that act as living umbrellas, shielding young cocoa from strong sun and keeping the soil cool and moist.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ mlɛo waa ni amɛshãa oya yɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi. Plantain lɛ daa oya ni eyɛ baai wuji ni tsuɔ nii tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋta. Buu kookoo bibii ahe kɛjɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ waa lɛ he. ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ feɔ fɛ̃i ni ehaa ŋmɔtɔ baa.

english: Why do I have to construct wooden stakes for my yam vines to climb on?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ matswa tso kɛha mi sweet potato wain tso lɛ koni makwɔ lɛ?

english: Yam vines need maximum sunlight on their leaves to make the energy required to grow big tubers underground. Staking keeps leaves off the wet ground where diseases easily spread and lifts them high into the sun.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ he miihia hulu la babaoo yɛ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni ekɛ hewalɛ ni he hiaa koni ekɛ bulbs wuji akwɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ aba. Staking yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa baai lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛjɛɔ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ ni helai baanyɛ agbɛ ashwã lɛ. Amɛgbɛɔ amɛshwãa mlɛo ni amɛwoɔ amɛ kɛyaa hulu la mli.

english: Hybrid maize seeds are specially bred from two unique parent lines to give high yields, but their offspring do not hold those same strong traits. Planting seeds saved from a hybrid harvest leads to uneven growth, smaller cobs, and lower total yields.
ga: Akɛ ŋmãa dumɔwui ni akɛfee ekome lɛ fɔ̃ɔ ŋmãa dumɔwui sɔrɔtoi enyɔ mli yɛ gbɛ krɛdɛɛ nɔ koni ekɛ yibiiwoo babaoo aba. Shi amɛshwiei lɛ bɛ sui ni mli wa tamɔ nɛkɛ. Dumɔwui ni ahere kɛjɛ hybrid ŋmɔshi nibii amli lɛ ni aduɔ lɛ baaha amɛdara ni kɛ amɛhe kpaaa gbee. Cob lɛ ji bibioo fe no. ni nibii fɛɛ ni afee lɛ ba shi

english: Cassava shows signs of maturity when its lower leaves naturally turn yellow and drop off, leaving a long bare stem, and the soil around the base of the plant begins to crack open from the growing tubers beneath.
ga: Yucca jieɔ dalɛ he okadii akpo kɛ́ shishigbɛ baai lɛ batsɔ ŋmɔŋ yɛ adebɔɔ naa ni amɛgbee shi. Tso kakadaŋŋ ko ni bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko eshwɛ. ni shikpɔŋ ni bɔle shishigbɛ lɛ bɔi fãmɔ kɛjɛ bulb ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ eshishi lɛ mli.

english: Why do my tomato plants wilt and die during the day even when the ground around them is wet?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato tsei lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ yɛ gbi lɛ mli eyɛ mli akɛ shikpɔŋ ni ebɔle amɛhe lɛ mli edɔ moŋ?

english: This sudden wilting is often caused by soil-borne bacteria or root rot fungi that block the water tubes inside the stem. Overwatering or poor drainage drowns the roots, preventing them from taking up water despite wet soil.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, helatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli loo shishifãi ni fiteɔ ni tsiɔ nu paipii ni yɔɔ tso lɛ mli lɛ anaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni baa trukaa nɛɛ baa. Nu ni akɛwoɔ mli fe nine loo nu ni hoɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ baaha shishifãi lɛ atsɔ nu mli. Etsiɔ shishifãi lɛ anaa koni amɛkaná nu kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ po.

english: Why do my maize leaves roll up tightly like drinking straws during the middle of the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa baai lɛ shwieɔ shi shiŋŋ tamɔ jwɛi ni anuɔ yɛ shwane mli lɛ?
